content:
Extract the invoice data from the document below into JSON with exactly this schema:

{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not applicable",
  "currency": "3-letter ISO code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 0.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0.00, "amount": 0.00}
  ]
}

Note: subtotal means all pre-tax charges (including shipping and after discounts).

Return only the JSON object, nothing else.

DOCUMENT:
JUNIPER CATERING & EVENTS
310 Wellington St W, Toronto, ON
GST/HST No: 84721 9932 RT0001

INVOICE JC-1188

Event date: July 30, 2025
Invoice date: August 2, 2025
Payment due: August 16, 2025
All prices in CAD.

Client: Maple Grove Tech Summit

--------------------------------------------------------------
 DESCRIPTION                      QTY    UNIT PRICE     AMOUNT
--------------------------------------------------------------
 Lunch buffet, per person          45       18.50       832.50
 Beverage package, per person      45        6.00       270.00
 Service staff (per staff)          3      120.00       360.00
--------------------------------------------------------------
                                        GST (5%):        73.13
                                        TOTAL:        1,535.63

Gratuity not included. E-transfer accepted.

```json
{
  "vendor_name": "JUNIPER CATERING & EVENTS",
  "invoice_number": "JC-1188",
  "invoice_date": "2025-08-02",
  "due_date": "2025-08-16",
  "currency": "CAD",
  "subtotal": 1462.50,
  "tax_amount": 73.13,
  "total": 1535.63,
  "line_items": [
    {
      "description": "Lunch buffet, per person",
      "quantity": 45,
      "unit_price": 18.50,
      "amount": 832.50
    },
    {
      "description": "Beverage package, per person",
      "quantity": 45,
      "unit_price": 6.00,
      "amount": 270.00
    },
    {
      "description": "Service staff (per staff)",
      "quantity": 3,
      "unit_price": 120.00,
      "amount": 360.00
    }
  ]
}
```
